blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Browser > Credentials Management > Credential Providers.
Locate the credential provider you want to edit, and click the Edit icon.

blocks.text: The Edit Credential Provider drawer opens.

blocks.item: In the Edit Credential Provider drawer, modify fields as necessary. To learn more about each field, see Configuring Credential Providers.

blocks.text: To learn more about Privileged Remote Access (PRA), see Understanding Privileged Remote Access. To set up PRA, see Step-by-Step Configuration Guide for Privileged Remote Access.
